lodgen.config.title: LODgen
lodgen.config.invalid: Invalid value. Check each setting’s tooltip.
lodgen.config.saveFailed: Could not save lodgen.toml. See the log.
lodgen.config.units: Distances are in chunks; X/Z are in blocks.
lodgen.config.enabled.tooltip:
Automatically starts a generation task when joining a new world

If distant horizons generator plan is disabled, this setting is ignored
lodgen.config.generationCenter.tooltip:
Choose the moving player position, the world’s spawn, or a fixed horizontal X/Z center.
Commands choose their own fixed center.
lodgen.config.centerX.tooltip:
Custom horizontal X coordinate in blocks.
Used only with Custom X/Z.
lodgen.config.centerZ.tooltip:
Custom horizontal Z coordinate in blocks.
Used only with Custom X/Z.
lodgen.config.generationDistance.tooltip:
Radius in chunks for chunk-based LOD generation.
0 uses DH’s or Voxy’s distance.
Positive values override it.

Changes apply immediately; running work finishes.
lodgen.config.savedChunkRadius.tooltip:
Square radius in chunks to save as ordinary terrain.
Default 0 keeps LOD-only terrain transient.
Normal player and Chunky chunks always retain their saves.
lodgen.config.caveMode.tooltip:
Generate: normal caves.
Fill: skip caves and underground features, filling with stone/deepslate.
Empty: generate air beneath the surface layers.

Trees, surface structures and water remain.
Saved and player chunks always generate normally.
Applies to newly generated LODs.
lodgen.config.cpuLoad.tooltip: More load = faster generation but more lag
lodgen.config.showChunksPerSecond.toolti:
Show completed LOD chunks per second, generation radius, estimated time remaining and status above the hotbar.
Hidden at zero throughput or when DH uses its own overlay.
lodgen.config.chunksPerSecondUpdateInter:
1–60000 milliseconds between action-bar updates.
Default: 1000 (one second).
The rate and ETA use the last five seconds of throughput.
Changes apply immediately.
